verdict: Every screen is built and connected to the real backend. Using the real app on 11 Nov showed that flows behind a click were often thinner than the Tauri app's, so every part of the app was checked control by control against it: Settings, the date control, the Timeline, Chat and Quick Recall, the main window chrome with onboarding and small windows, and Insights. Roughly 250 differences were found and fixed, among them several actions that deleted or lost data without asking. On 12 Nov the dev build crashed after six hours: opening Insights started writing the week's summary with the AI model on a thread with too little room, and it ran out. That is fixed for every backend call the app makes, with a test that crashed before the fix. Everything is in local commits; nothing is pushed. Every screenshot is approved. What needs you: a hands-on pass in the real app, since none of this has been used by hand yet.
